description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

First migrate literal consumers of the Makefile contract files and Makefile text (tests/unit/test_standardized_test_commands.py remnants, tests/system/test_ci_lint_parity.py, scripts/check_release_curation.py if kept, docs). Then restructure into grouped modules under make/ with a short root Makefile. Modules that already exist: documentation.mk, help.mk, platform-tests.mk, site-inputs.mk, worktree-maintenance.mk, worktrees.mk. Add test, quality, build, reports and uat modules as needed; move cross-surface equivalence report targets to make/reports.mk; keep docker/live/UAT/data-generator targets. The site-split-50 deletions remove the docs-build, site-* and explorer targets first, so do not create docs or explorer modules for them. Consolidate duplicate test aliases (test-quick, test-fast, test-dev, test-pytest, test-verbose, test-parallel, test-parallel-fast, test-full, test-all, test-ci, test-medium, test-medium-selected, test-smoke, test-window, test-no-cloud, test-olap) into tier targets; aliases print the replacement for one release, then are removed in a follow-up.

The contract files already exist: make/check_makefile_inventory.py, make/monolith-baseline.json and make/migration-proof.json are tracked. make/inventory.json is generated and git-ignored (.gitignore:195, #2575). Replace the four contract pieces and the makefile-inventory-check target with one test: every make target named in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, and the skill-sync source resolves with make -n.

Measure the baseline again before starting. On origin/develop (2026-10-09) `make -pRrq : | awk -v RS= -F: '/^# Files/,/^# Finished Make data base/ {if ($1 !~ "^[#.]") {print $1}}' | sort -u | grep -E -v -e '^[^[:alnum:]]' -e '^\$@$'` lists 241 targets; make/monolith-baseline.json records 195 public targets; the Makefile has 1532 lines and the six modules 695 more.
